title: Deploy behind an air gap

scenes.heading: Public registry access is closed
scenes.sub: Plan the inputs before crossing the gap
scenes.detail: Target can reach a private registry
voice: The cluster cannot reach public registries.
Stage the charts and images before installing, or a pull can fail even with the correct configuration.

scenes.heading: Discover what the recipe references
voice: AICR mirror list renders the component charts with the recipe values.
The inventory lists the image and chart references for a mirroring workflow to stage.

scenes.heading: Bring the dependencies across
scenes.sub: Mirror images and vendor chart bytes
voice: Use your mirroring tool to copy the required images to the private registry.
Vendoring carries the Helm chart bytes in the bundle, ready for the disconnected install.

scenes.heading: Deploy from reachable sources
scenes.sub: Hand the staged inputs to the deployer
voice: Point the deployment at those mirrored image locations and use the vendored charts.
Your deployment tool now has the configuration and the inputs it can reach.

viewer: Platform operator preparing an air-gapped cluster
payoff: Build a reachable package for an isolated cluster by discovering, mirroring, and vendoring the recipe’s actual dependencies.
